package conditionstudy
namespace conditionstudy
entity Integer id "conditionstudy://integer"
activity Choose(Integer) -> Integer computes "if input < 0 { return 0 - input } else { return input }" assembling {
 choice "comparison" operand_order at "0" intent "Compare whether the input is negative."
 choice "branches" branch_layout at "0" intent "Use the true branch for negative inputs."
 case "-9" -> "9"
 case "-2" -> "2"
 case "0" -> "0"
 case "2" -> "2"
 case "9" -> "9"
 case "-9007199254740995" -> "9007199254740995"
 case "9007199254740995" -> "9007199254740995"
 condition_case "comparison" input "-9007199254740995" -> "true"
 condition_case "comparison" input "0" -> "false"
 condition_case "comparison" input "9007199254740995" -> "false"
 attempts "4"
}

decisions.intent: Compare whether the input is negative.
Use the true branch for negative inputs.
